verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five kinds of stinginess.
Stinginess with dwellings, families, material things, praise, and the teaching.
These are the five kinds of stinginess.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ macchariyānaṁ pahānāya …pe… ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā”ti.
verses.english: To give up these five kinds of stinginess you should develop the four kinds of mindfulness meditation. …”
